belgian_pro_league.name: Belgian Pro League
belgian_pro_league.text: Club Brugge's 5-1 win at KV Mechelen was the biggest margin of the recent Belgian Pro League results. There were draws as Royal Charleroi SC and Sint-Truidense finished 2-2, Zulte-Waregem and Antwerp also drew 2-2, and OH Leuven and KV Kortrijk played out a 2-2 draw.

bundesliga.name: Bundesliga
bundesliga.text: Bayer 04 Leverkusen and SV Werder Bremen each recorded 4-0 wins, the biggest margins of the recent Bundesliga results. FC Schalke 04 and VfB Stuttgart played out a 0-0 draw, while SV Werder Bremen and Borussia Mönchengladbach shared a 3-3 draw.

champions_league.name: Champions League
champions_league.text: Real Madrid CF recorded the biggest margin of the recent Champions League results with a 5-1 win over PSV Eindhoven. There were also draws as Arsenal FC and Borussia Dortmund finished 1-1, Manchester City FC and SSC Napoli played out 2-2, Paris Saint-Germain FC and AS Roma drew 2-2, and Sporting CP and Manchester United FC ended 2-2.

conference_league.name: Conference League
conference_league.text: Ajax Amsterdam, Braga and Brighton & Hove Albion FC each recorded 4-0 wins, the biggest margins of the recent Conference League results. KAA Gent and Red Star Belgrade played out a 1-1 draw.

eredivisie.name: Eredivisie
eredivisie.text: AZ Alkmaar's 5-1 win at Sparta Rotterdam was the biggest margin of the recent Eredivisie round, while PSV Eindhoven won 4-1 at NEC Nijmegen. The only draw was FC Groningen 1-1 Willem II.

europa_league.name: Europa League
europa_league.text: In the latest Europa League results, Viktoria Plzen's 4-0 win over Benfica was the biggest margin, while Juventus beat Omonia Nicosia 4-1. There were four draws: Ferencvaros 0-0 NK Celje, Olympique Lyonnais 0-0 Lillestrom, Sunderland 1-1 Jagiellonia Bialystok, and Union St.-Gilloise 2-2 Lech Poznan.

la_liga.name: La Liga
la_liga.text: Getafe CF's 0-3 defeat to Club Atlético de Madrid was the biggest margin of the recent La Liga results. Sevilla FC drew 1-1 with Real Betis Balompié, and Levante UD drew 1-1 with Elche CF.

ligue_1.name: Ligue 1
ligue_1.text: Paris FC's 4-0 win over Angers SCO was the biggest margin of the recent Ligue 1 results. Draws were recorded by AS Monaco against AJ Auxerre, Racing Club de Lens against Toulouse FC, and FC Lorient against Stade Rennais FC 1901.

premier_league.name: Premier League
premier_league.text: Liverpool FC and Brentford FC each recorded 4-0 wins, over Manchester United FC and Everton FC respectively, while Chelsea FC's 1-4 loss to Leeds United FC matched that margin. Draws came between Manchester City FC and Fulham FC (1-1), Aston Villa FC and Sunderland AFC (0-0), and Newcastle United FC and Arsenal FC (2-2).

primeira_liga.name: Primeira Liga
primeira_liga.text: C.D. Nacional beat Maritimo 2-1 in the most recent Primeira Liga match. That 2-1 result was the biggest margin among the listed games, and there were no draws.

serie_a.name: Serie A
serie_a.text: Parma Calcio 1913 suffered the biggest margin of the recent Serie A results, losing 1-5 to AS Roma, while AC Milan also won 5-1 against Frosinone Calcio. There were two draws: Bologna FC 1909 and Udinese Calcio finished 1-1, Atalanta BC and FC Internazionale Milano played out a 4-4 draw, and Venezia FC versus Bologna FC 1909 ended 0-0.

super_lig.name: Süper Lig
super_lig.text: Recent Süper Lig results saw Konyaspor beat Besiktas 4-2 for the biggest margin, while Kocaelispor and Fenerbahce drew 2-2. Istanbul Basaksehir also won 4-2 against Çorum FK, and Caykur Rizespor edged Kasimpasa 3-2.
